sections.section_title: DCMIPP Pipex pixel packer memory2 address register 1 (DCMIPP_PxPPM2AR1)
sections.text_helper: Section 39.14.94 "DCMIPP Pipex pixel packer memory2 address register 1 (DCMIPP_PxPPM2AR1)" in chapter 39 (Digital camera interface pixel pipeline (DCMIPP)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1963.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x9E4 + 0x400 * (x - 1), (x = 1 to 1)
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:0 M2A[31:0]: Memory 2 address
Base address of memory area 2 to whom data are written. It is assumed to be a multiple of
16, hence its bits 3:0 are always at 0x0.
